mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates increase the discount rate for equity cash flows and reduce the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units, it indicates an overheating economy that may trigger aggressive monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% AND HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an economic recession, which typically leads to a market rebound as investors anticipate policy support and the eventual end of the downturn, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ growth is negative, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and the monthly change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth is below 0.5%, it indicates a cooling labor market that may prompt the Federal Reserve to pause rate hikes, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% AND PAYEMS growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS and 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
